evaluation_summary: Flat-plane mass-conservation and symmetry checks pass; not validated against gauge events.
intended_use: Screening-level 2D floodplain inundation mapping for planning and public communication. Not a regulatory determination.
limitations: Zero-inertia (diffusion-wave) approximation: no shocks, no supercritical flow.
No infiltration or evapotranspiration; volumes are conservative.
Lumped uniform rainfall input; no channel routing or baseflow.
